AWS S3 Public Buckets\n13\t\n14\t### 1.1 NOAA GFS (Global Forecast System)\n15\t\n16\t**Archive:** [NOAA GFS-BDP-PDS](https://registry.opendata.aws/noaa-gfs-bdp-pds/)  \n17\t**S3 Bucket:** `s3://noaa-gfs-bdp-pds`  \n18\t**Region:** us-east-1  \n19\t**Format:** GRIB2\n20\t\n21\t#### Directory Structure\n22\t```\n23\ts3://noaa-gfs-bdp-pds/\n24\t├── gfs.YYYYMMDD/\n25\t│   ├── 00/\n26\t│   │   ├── gfs.t00z.pgrb2.0p25.f000\n27\t│   │   ├── gfs.t00z.pgrb2.0p25.f003\n28\t│   │   └── ...\n29\t│   ├── 06/\n30\t│   ├── 12/\n31\t│   └── 18/\n32\t└── gdas.YYYYMMDD/\n33\t    └── hh-6/\n34\t        └── RESTART/\n35\t```\n36\t\n37\t#### Naming Convention\n38\t- **Pattern:** `gfs.tCCz.pgrb2.0p25.fFFF`\n39\t- **Components:**\n40\t  - `CC` = Model cycle (00, 06, 12, 18 UTC)\n41\t  - `0p25` = 0.25° resolution\n42\t  - `FFF` = Forecast hour (000-384)\n43\t\n44\t#### CONUS Coverage\n45\tGFS is global but includes CONUS in the full domain.\n46\t\n47\t**Explorer:** https://noaa-gfs-bdp-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html  \n48\t**Documentation:** https://www.nco.ncep.noaa.gov/pmb/products/gfs/\n49\t\n50\t---\n51\t\n52\t### 1.2 NOAA HRRR (High-Resolution Rapid Refresh)\n53\t\n54\t**Archive:** [NOAA HRRR-PDS](https://registry.opendata.aws/noaa-hrrr-pds/)  \n55\t**S3 Buckets:** \n56\t- `s3://noaa-hrrr-bdp-pds` (us-east-1)\n57\t- `s3://hrrrzarr` (us-west-1) - Zarr format\n58\t\n59\t#### Directory Structure\n60\t```\n61\ts3://noaa-hrrr-bdp-pds/\n62\t└── hrrr.YYYYMMDD/\n63\t    ├── 00/\n64\t    │   ├── hrrr.t00z.wrfsfcf00.grib2\n65\t    │   ├── hrrr.t00z.wrfprsf00.grib2\n66\t    │   └── ...\n67\t    ├── 01/\n68\t    ├── 02/\n69\t    └── ... (hourly cycles 00-23)\n70\t```\n71\t\n72\t#### Naming Convention\n73\t- **Pattern:** `hrrr.tCCz.wrfsfcfFF.grib2` (surface) or `hrrr.tCCz.wrfprsFF.grib2` (pressure)\n74\t- **Components:**\n75\t  - `CC` = Model cycle (00-23 UTC, hourly)\n76\t  - `FF` = Forecast hour (00-18)\n77\t  - `wrfsfc` = Surface fields\n78\t  - `wrfprs` = Pressure fields\n79\t\n80\t#### CONUS Coverage\n81\t- **Resolution:** 3-km\n82\t- **Domain:** CONUS (cloud-resolving, convection-allowing)\n83\t- **Update frequency:** Hourly\n84\t\n85\t**Explorer:** https://noaa-hrrr-bdp-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html\n86\t\n87\t---\n88\t\n89\t### 1.3 NOAA READY Gridded Data Archives\n90\t\n91\t**Archive:** [NOAA READY](https://www.ready.noaa.gov/archives.php)  \n92\t**S3 Bucket:** `s3://noaa-oar-arl-hysplit-pds`  \n93\t**Maintainer:** NOAA Air Resources Laboratory\n94\t\n95\t#### Directory Structure\n96\t```\n97\ts3://noaa-oar-arl-hysplit-pds/\n98\t├── gfs0p25/\n99\t│   ├── 2023/\n100\t│   ├── 2024/\n101\t│   ├── 2025/\n102\t│   └── listing.md5.txt\n103\t├── nam12km/\n104\t│   ├── 2007/\n105\t│   ├── 2008/\n106\t│   └── ...\n107\t└── hrrr/\n108\t    ├── 2019/\n109\t    └── ...\n110\t```\n111\t\n112\t#### Available CONUS Datasets\n113\t- **GFS 0.25°** (June 2019-present)\n114\t- **NAM 12 km** (May 2007-present)\n115\t- **HRRR 3 km** (June 2019-present)\n116\t- **NAMS Hybrid sigma-pressure** (2010-present)\n117\t\n118\t**Format:** 1-byte packing algorithm, GRIB format\n119\t\n120\t---\n121\t\n122\t## 2. NCEP FTP/HTTPS Archives\n123\t\n124\t### 2.1 NCEP GFS/GDAS Data Products\n125\t\n126\t**Primary:** [NCEP Data Products - GFS](https://www.nco.ncep.noaa.gov/pmb/products/gfs/)\n127\t\n128\t#### FTP/HTTPS Access\n129\t- **FTP:** `ftp://ftp.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/gfs/prod/`\n130\t- **HTTPS:** `https://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/gfs/prod/`\n131\t\n132\t#### Directory Structure\n133\t```\n134\t/pub/data/nccf/com/gfs/prod/\n135\t├── gfs.YYYYMMDD/\n136\t│   ├── 00/\n137\t│   │   ├── gfs.t00z.pgrb2.0p25.f000\n138\t│   │   ├── gfs.t00z.pgrb2.0p25.f003\n139\t│   │   └── ...\n140\t│   ├── 06/\n141\t│   ├── 12/\n142\t│   └── 18/\n143\t└── gdas.YYYYMMDD/\n144\t    └── hh-6/\n145\t        └── RESTART/\n146\t```\n147\t\n148\t#### Naming Conventions\n149\t- **GFS:** `gfs.tCCz.[type].fFFF`\n150\t  - `[type]` = `pgrb2.0p25`, `pgrb2.0p50`, `pgrb2.1p00`, `pgrb2full.0p50`, `sfluxgrbfFFF.grib2`\n151\t  - `.nc` = NetCDF format (`atmanl.nc`, `sfcfFFF.nc`)\n152\t\n153\t---\n154\t\n155\t### 2.2 NCEP NAM Data Products\n156\t\n157\t**Primary:** [NCEP Data Products - NAM](https://www.nco.ncep.noaa.gov/pmb/products/nam/)\n158\t\n159\t#### FTP/HTTPS Access\n160\t- **FTP:** `ftp://ftp.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/nam/prod/`\n161\t- **HTTPS:** `https://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/nam/prod/`\n162\t- **NWS FTP:** `ftp://tgftp.nws.noaa.gov/SL.us008001/ST.opnl/MT.nam_CY.00`\n163\t\n164\t#### Directory Structure\n165\t```\n166\t/pub/data/nccf/com/nam/prod/\n167\t└── nam.YYYYMMDD/\n168\t    ├── nam.tCCz.conusnest.hiresfFF.tm00.grib2\n169\t    ├── nam.tCCz.firewxnest.hiresfFF.tm00.grib2\n170\t    ├── nam.tCCz.awphysFF.tm00.grib2\n171\t    └── ...\n172\t```\n173\t\n174\t#### Naming Convention\n175\t- **Pattern:** `nam.tCCz.[dataset].tm00.grib2`\n176\t- **Components:**\n177\t  - `CC` = Model cycle (00, 06, 12, 18 UTC)\n178\t  - `YYYYMMDDhh` = Timestamp\n179\t\n180\t#### Available CONUS Datasets\n181\t\n182\t| Dataset | Resolution | Grid | Description | Filename Template |\n183\t|---------|------------|------|-------------|-------------------|\n184\t| NAM NEST CONUS | 5 km | Grid 227 | High-resolution nest | `nam.tCCz.conusnest.hiresfFF.tm00.grib2` |\n185\t| Fire Weather Nest | 1.33 km | Dynamic | On-Call Nest | `nam.tCCz.firewxnest.hiresfFF.tm00.grib2` |\n186\t| AWIPS Grid 218 | 12 km | 218 | Pressure + surface | `nam.tCCz.awphysFF.tm00.grib2` |\n187\t| AWIPS Grid 218 (surface) | 12 km | 218 | Surface only | `nam.tCCz.awip12FF.tm00.grib2` |\n188\t| AWIPS Grid 215 | 20 km | 215 | CONUS regional | `nam.tCCz.awip20FF.tm00.grib2` |\n189\t| Smartinit NDFD | 5 km | Grid 197 | CONUS smartinit | `nam.tCCz.smartconusFF.tm00.grib2` |\n190\t\n191\t---\n192\t\n193\t### 2.3 NCEP RAP Data Products\n194\t\n195\t**Primary:** [NCEP Data Products - RAP](https://www.nco.ncep.noaa.gov/pmb/products/rap/)\n196\t\n197\t#### FTP/HTTPS Access\n198\t- **FTP:** `ftp://ftp.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/rap/prod`\n199\t- **HTTPS:** `https://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/rap/prod`\n200\t- **NWS FTP:** `ftp://tgftp.nws.noaa.gov/SL.us008001/ST.opnl/MT.rap_CY.00`\n201\t\n202\t#### Directory Structure\n203\t```\n204\t/pub/data/nccf/com/rap/prod/\n205\t└── rap.YYYYMMDD/\n206\t    ├── rap.tCCz.awp130pgrbf00.grib2\n207\t    ├── rap.tCCz.awp252pgrbf00.grib2\n208\t    └── ...\n209\t```\n210\t\n211\t#### Naming Convention\n212\t- **Pattern:** `rap.tCCz.awpXXXpgrbfYY.grib2` or `rap.tCCz.awpXXXbgrbfYY.grib2`\n213\t- **Components:**\n214\t  - `CC` = Model cycle (hourly)\n215\t  - `XXX` = Grid identifier (130 = 13km, 252 = 20km, 236 = 40km)\n216\t  - `pgrb` = Pressure levels\n217\t  - `bgrb` = Native levels\n218\t  - `YY` = Forecast hour\n219\t\n220\t#### Available CONUS Datasets\n221\t\n222\t| Region | Resolution | Type | Filename |\n223\t|--------|------------|------|-----------|\n224\t| CONUS | 13-km | Pressure Levels | `rap.tCCz.awp130pgrbfYY.grib2` |\n225\t| CONUS | 20-km | Pressure Levels | `rap.tCCz.awp252pgrbfYY.grib2` |\n226\t| CONUS | 40-km | Pressure Levels | `rap.tCCz.awp236pgrbfYY.grib2` |\n227\t| CONUS | 13-km | Native Levels | `rap.tCCz.awp130bgrbfYY.grib2` |\n228\t| CONUS | 20-km | Native Levels | `rap.tCCz.awp252bgrbfYY.grib2` |\n229\t\n230\t**Forecast extent:** FH21 standard, FH51 extended (03, 09, 15, 21 UTC only)\n231\t\n232\t---\n233\t\n234\t## 3. NOAA NOMADS (NOAA Operational Model Archive and Distribution System)\n235\t\n236\t**Portal:** [https://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/](https://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/)\n237\t\n238\t### Access Methods\n239\t\n240\t#### 3.1 GRIB Filter Service\n241\t**Documentation:** https://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/info.php?page=gribfilter\n242\t\n243\t- Web application for subsetting GRIB2 files\n244\t- Filter by parameters, levels, forecast times\n245\t- Direct download of filtered subsets\n246\t\n247\t#### 3.2 Fast Download with Random Access\n248\t**Documentation:** https://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/info.php?page=fastdownload\n249\t\n250\t- Random-access reading via HTTP\n251\t- Requires index file (.idx)\n252\t- Efficient for downloading subsets\n253\t\n254\t#### 3.3 Direct HTTP Access\n255\t**Base URL:** `https://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/`\n256\t\n257\t**Models available:**\n258\t- **GFS** - Global Forecast System\n259\t- **NAM** - North American Mesoscale (CONUS 12km)\n260\t- **RAP** - Rapid Refresh (CONUS 13km, 20km)\n261\t- **HRRR** - High-Resolution Rapid Refresh (CONUS 3km)\n262\t- **GDAS** - Global Data Assimilation System\n263\t\n264\t### GRIB Filter Examples\n265\t- **HIRESW CONUS:** https://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/gribfilter.php?ds=hiresconus\n266\t- **NAM CONUS:** https://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/cgi-bin/filter_nam_conusnest.pl\n267\t\n268\t---\n269\t\n270\t## 4. Access Methods Summary\n358\t\n359\t### Command Line Access\n360\t\n361\t#### AWS S3 (no credentials required)\n362\t```bash\n363\t# List GFS data\n364\taws s3 ls --no-sign-request s3://noaa-gfs-bdp-pds/gfs.20260724/00/\n365\t\n366\t# List HRRR data\n367\taws s3 ls --no-sign-request s3://noaa-hrrr-bdp-pds/hrrr.20260724/00/\n368\t\n369\t# Download file\n370\taws s3 cp --no-sign-request \\\n371\t  s3://noaa-gfs-bdp-pds/gfs.20260724/00/gfs.t00z.pgrb2.0p25.f000 \\\n372\t  ./gfs.t00z.pgrb2.0p25.f000.grib2\n373\t```\n374\t\n375\t#### NCEP FTP (anonymous)\n376\t```bash\n377\t# FTP access\n378\tftp ftp.ncep.noaa.gov\n379\tcd /pub/data/nccf/com/gfs/prod/gfs.20260724/00/\n380\t\n381\t# Or with wget/curl\n382\twget ftp://ftp.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/gfs/prod/gfs.20260724/00/gfs.t00z.pgrb2.0p25.f000\n383\tcurl -O https://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/gfs/prod/gfs.20260724/00/gfs.t00z.pgrb2.0p25.f000\n384\t```\n385\t\n386\t#### NOMADS HTTP\n387\t```bash\n388\t# Direct HTTP download\n389\tcurl -O https://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/nam/prod/nam.20260724/nam.t12z.conusnest.hiresf00.tm00.grib2\n390\t```\n391\t\n392\t### Python Tools\n393\t\n394\t- **Herbie:** Popular package for downloading GRIB data from multiple sources\n395\t  - GitHub: https://github.com/blaylockbk/Herbie\n396\t- **rNOMADS:** R package for NOMADS access\n397\t- **NOMADS API:** Direct HTTP access with filtering\n398\t\n399\t---\n400\t\n401\t## 9.
